## User Story

As a [type of user],
I need [a feature or functionality],
So that [the benefit or goal].

## Acceptance Criteria

### Scenario 1: Successful operation

Given [the required initial conditions]
When [the user performs an action]
Then [the expected outcome occurs]

### Scenario 2: Error handling

Given [an invalid condition or missing resource]
When [the user performs an action]
Then [the system returns an appropriate error response]

## Definition of Done

- [ ] Functionality meets the acceptance criteria.
- [ ] Input validation and error handling are implemented.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Changes are reviewed and documented where necessary.
